summary: 13 years shipping production software, most of it on high-traffic web platforms and the visual builders that feed them.

roles.title: Senior Web Developer
roles.note: Build and ship pages across dialpad.com, a Next.js App Router site on Vercel: ~1,900 pages across five locales, serving millions of visitors. Built most of a WYSIWYG blog builder in Next.js, now live: each block's form comes from its Contentful content model, so a new field rarely needs UI work. It drafts with the Anthropic SDK, where Claude streams a draft that an editor approves before it enters a post. React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind on the front end, with GraphQL queries and resolvers in a layer the team owns. Performance, SEO and accessibility are release criteria.

roles.title: Web Developer
roles.note: Built and maintained high-traffic marketing pages across Dialpad's global web platform.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
roles.note: High-performance web solutions for major digital platforms: a low-code drag-and-drop page builder in Angular for mobile storefronts, and web showcases for Google Chromecast focused on interactivity and cross-device performance.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.note: Marketing pages for Google's Small Business initiatives (smallbusiness.withgoogle.com) in AngularJS, reaching millions of visitors monthly, plus a WYSIWYG page builder that let the team assemble campaign pages without engineering time. Held performance and WCAG compliance across high-traffic pages.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
roles.note: Built the platform behind Wrap (wrap.co) from scratch at an early-stage startup: app-like interactive content that runs inside messaging feeds with no app install. Node.js and Express services on MongoDB behind an Angular front end, with user, team and permission management, and a modular service architecture so new content formats could be added independently of the generator.

roles.title: Web Developer
roles.note: Co-engineered JPMorgan's migration from a legacy ActionScript system to a full Angular platform, rebuilding the stock calculation interfaces used by brokers on top of the bank's existing back end, and refactoring interfaces for WCAG compliance.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.note: FinTech and PropTech modules for the Swiss financial sector: financial planning, tax and real estate, in Angular and TypeScript.

roles.title: Web Developer
roles.note: Data-driven digital experiences for the automotive sector, including the promotional rewards platform for GM's "GM Card" program. Built in AngularJS for the US market, letting cardholders track their earnings and vehicle benefits.

roles.title: Java Web Developer
roles.note: Large-scale telecom web solutions at HP's enterprise division, including a nationwide interactive mobile platform launched in Nextel stores. Built in J2SE, JBoss Seam, JSF and JavaScript, maintaining workflows for multi-million endpoint environments.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional
